text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant*... For the first time in a while...
I was able to run without hesitation...!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: I was fumbling in the dark... but somehow made it through on pure grit!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
*pant*, *pant*... She's strong, no doubt, but
without her smartphone videos, she's definitely not as sharp as before.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Even so...!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Tran's Trainer.
You're filming today too, right?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Point that camera right at me!
There's something I gotta say!
Of course, my Cinema Gun was rolling today as well. And I pointed that lens right at Espoir City.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Tran. How was my run?
Did you get good footage? And also...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"Listen to me! Don't sweat it just because
your old data got wiped! Because—"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: I am... right here!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"If you mess it up, we can just reshoot it!
We can just do it over again!"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: If that's what you want, I'll run as many times as it takes—again and again and again!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: So don't you dare look so disappointed, got it?!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: That's all. ...The end.
Through the camera... Espoir City cheered Transcend on.

Her words may be rough...
but they're heartfelt cheers...
choice_data_list: Thank you... What a good girl...
Thank you... What a good girl...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"I-It's not like I'm a good kid or anything...
I just went and complained, that's all..."

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Wh-whoa, you don't need to film anymore!
That's a wrap! It's over, dammit!

I captured it all on camera.
The data on your running, and all the gentleness at your core.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Thanks, Espo-n.
...Yeah, you're right.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"I'm gonna start gathering it all over again.
All the data on the other Umamusume, too."

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, you'd better.
...See ya.

And so, the Mile Championship Nambu Hai reached its conclusion.
A thrilling race and a refreshing friendship were successfully delivered to the north.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: "Man, Espo-n totally got the better of us today, huh?"

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Just start over from scratch. Yeah, exactly.
I don't even have a single comeback to that.

As I thought about it, a question crossed my mind.
Transcend's current situation is...
choice_data_list: It might be a bit similar.
They might be a bit alike, huh.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Huh, we look alike...?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
People working toward reconstruction...
Ah, I see...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: The current me is—

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
I lost all the precious data I had built up.
To me, that was...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: —Infrastructure. It was indispensable for building up her running.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"To get it all back.
To start from scratch and build up a collection again...?"

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"...It really is similar, isn't it?
The scale of seriousness may differ... but in terms of reconstruction, yes."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: "People having a much harder time aren't giving up, so there's no way I can let myself falter."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
And if I can turn things around
and reach the top of the dirt racing world—
choice_data_list: Yeah, that's the best encouragement I could ask for!
Yeah, that's the best encouragement I could ask for!

text_block_list.text:
Some things can never be regained.
Yet most... surely can be.
"Transcend has to show it through her running, through her results."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Alright, Trai-chan.
Next! Let's move on to the next one!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
First, I need to retake the data
for Julio and Falco-chan.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Do we have a read on their movements?

Those two look likely to enter a certain GⅠ.
If I can acquire data from them again there—

The Cinemagun is almost restored.
The race those two are likely to appear in is—
choice_data_list: The JBC Classic is the most likely choice.
The JBC Classic is our best bet.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"The JBC Classic, huh? A month from now...
That's coming right up. Nice and simple—suits me just fine."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
All right, let's work hard toward that!
To bring out the potential in both of them,
I've gotta get stronger myself!
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's give it everything we've got!

text_block_list.text:
I can hear—the pulse.
The heartbeat toward revival.

First, at the JBC Classic, let us gather
all the data on the Big Three once again.
